purpose: Proportions measured from the reference photographs and used by tools/build_from_photos.py. No vertex data is taken from any existing STL.

method.side_scale: 900 nominal units / 2169 px = 0.41494 units per px
method.wheel_detection: connected components of dark pixels below y=950; rim circles 230x228 px and 232x232 px
method.rear_light_bar: red-pixel bbox x 644..1678, y 978..1057; centre at 0.635 of vehicle height, span 0.884 of vehicle width

notes: Front and rear photographs are perspective images, so widths taken from them are used only as ratios (roof/body, bar/body), never as absolute lengths.
Overall length is normalised to 900 nominal units so the from-scratch model frames identically to the earlier corrected model.
Values are rounded; the generator keeps them in one PROPORTIONS table.
